existingProcessException.reason: Previously open editor lost its last Viewer at 03:22:57 UTC, coinciding with the protected tunnel route change; manager scheduled one-minute vacant cleanup and observed session stop at 03:23:57 UTC. Saved document hashes are unchanged. The retained old listener did not guarantee uninterrupted existing connections.
existingProcessException.evidence: Manager lifecycle log; old/new process snapshots
existingProcessException.oldListenerClientContinuity: Listener retained; cannot claim every pre-existing Viewer remained connected.

limits: A second edge listener preserves rollback but does not guarantee existing WebSocket continuity across a Cloudflare tunnel route update. The US pre-existing editor lost both Viewers five seconds after the route update and stopped one minute later under its vacant-session policy. Its saved documents were unchanged; Core and managed desktop were not restarted.
US disposable test App used WSS; Australia and China exercised both UDP and WSS. The full UDP fault matrix was not repeated for this HTML-only update.
Physical OS input methods, other browser engines and a new soak were not repeated. Narrow layouts were viewport emulations, not physical phone acceptance.
Old edge listeners remain running and available for rollback; retirement is a separate operation.
One preview attempt found clipped metrics under the headless fullscreen viewport; the bottom-rail minimum height was corrected before the accepted candidate and passing checks.
